backend/main.mo: Defines storage mixin usage and two public types for render rules and Genesis Craft preview metadata.
feature_evidence.json: Report describing feature requirements, associated files, components, and test IDs for multiple dashboard‑related UI updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities and changes across many frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and component layers defining light and dark theme CSS variables and global styling utilities.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component managing routing, project types, validation, persistence, and global UI elements like header, footer, and dialogs.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable confirmation dialog that triggers destructive actions with confirm/cancel handlers.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: Modal dialog for creating a new project with fields for name, symbol, size, and pixel-art mode.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: Clickable tile used on the dashboard for starting creation of a new project.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: Dialog for editing an existing project's name, symbol, size, and pixel-art mode with validation.
Dashboard tile showing project metadata with actions for opening, editing settings, and deleting the project.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer with branding, attribution link, and heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive navigation header showing project context, view switching, and save status indicator with mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Lightweight hover/focus tooltip wrapper that displays a styled popover above its child element.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Provides a dialog explaining how to obtain and use a Pinata JWT token, including warnings and step-by-step instructions.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Displays a small text-based indicator showing save state such as saving, saved, or idle without shifting layout.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Renders controls for locking a collection, unlocking it, and uploading it to IPFS with state handling and progress updates.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle component allowing users to switch between compact and grid view modes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity authentication, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Provides a Zustand store and hook to open a confirmation dialog and return a Promise resolving to a user’s confirm or cancel action.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity React context and provider managing AuthClient creation, login flow, stored identities, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Validates a Pinata JWT with debouncing, exposing status and message through a custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend queries are used.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, custom variables, motion settings, and utility classes for UI styling and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Provides the NFT builder interface with image layer previews, file uploads, and token generation logic.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the project dashboard with project creation, settings editing, deletion confirmation, and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Handles random trait selection, rule validation, and canvas layer merging to preview generated NFT images.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Provides UI to edit, normalize, and lock trait rarity weights per layer with automatic validation and adjustments.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Manages creation, editing, duplication, and deletion of trait compatibility rules for NFT generation.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Provides project-wide settings management including metadata format, blockchain syncing, Pinata validation, and Solana creator configuration.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Controls generation, filtering, sorting, previewing, and exporting of the full NFT collection using a worker and custom ZIP builder.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: React UI for managing project layers and traits, including add/edit/delete, drag ordering, and rule cleanup. Updates project state and shows toasts for user actions.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Handles uploading NFT images and metadata to IPFS via Pinata, including progress reporting and CID generation. Builds metadata and assembles directory uploads for collections.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Generates metadata objects for preview and export with support for multiple blockchain formats. Resolves templates and builds image URIs, attributes, and creator fields.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Provides atomic localStorage save/load utilities with last‑write‑wins behavior. Includes legacy cleanup, size estimation, and quota checks.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Wrapper for Pinata API to validate JWT tokens and upload files, JSON, or directories to IPFS. Returns structured success/error results with CIDs.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines message and data schemas for NFT generation worker communication, including layers, traits, rules, and generation events. Provides type guards for worker output messages.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Utility that yields to the browser event loop to keep UI responsive during long tasks.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Web Worker handling NFT generation logic including trait selection, rule checks, DNA uniqueness, and optional OffscreenCanvas image compositing. Also builds metadata and returns progress/outputs to the main thread.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS config extending colors, spacing, fonts, animations, and enabling class-based dark mode for the frontend. Defines custom keyframes, utilities, and responsive breakpoints for app styling.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot describing the app’s schema version, full feature summary, and detailed lists of existing features for the generative NFT studio. Used for tracking capabilities and planning future requirements.
